name: American Tower Corporation
tagline: Leading global owner and operator of multitenant communications real estate
hero_kpi_rationale: Représente 97% des revenus totaux et reflète la valeur fondamentale du modèle économique de location d'infrastructure de communication, avec plus de 54 milliards de dollars de revenus non annulables attendus sur les périodes futures

kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from leasing space on communications sites to wireless service providers, broadcasters, and other tenants
kpis.signal: Recurring revenue from long-term, non-cancellable customer leases
kpis.description: Revenue generated from leasing space on communications sites to wireless service providers, broadcasters, and other tenants

kpis.explanation: Total number of communications sites owned or operated globally
kpis.signal: Diversified global portfolio of communications infrastructure
kpis.description: Total number of communications sites owned or operated globally

kpis.signal: Diversified data center portfolio across eleven U.S. markets
kpis.description: Total net rentable square footage of operating data center facilities across the United States

stories_kpis.explanation: Revenue lost from tenant lease cancellations, non-renewal of leases or rent renegotiations as a percentage of tenant billings
stories_kpis.signal: Historically immaterial impact from churn, indicating strong lease retention and customer stability
stories_kpis.description: Revenue lost from tenant lease cancellations, non-renewal of leases or rent renegotiations as a percentage of tenant billings

ai_positioning.summary: American Tower Corporation acknowledges artificial intelligence and technological changes as emerging risk factors that could affect customer demand for communications infrastructure and network deployment strategies. AI is mentioned in the context of technological disruption risks, including potential changes in wireless equipment, RAN sharing adoption, and network deployment patterns.
evidence: Factors affecting leasing demand include 'technological changes, including artificial intelligence (AI), wireless equipment changes, satellite technology and an increase in the use of radio access network (RAN) sharing among wireless service providers'

risks.title: Decreased Leasing Demand for Communications Infrastructure
risks.score_rationale: A significant reduction in leasing demand would materially and adversely affect business and operating results. Risk is driven by wireless/cloud provider capex decisions, communications service provider consolidation, economic conditions, and technological changes including AI and RAN sharing. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Significant decrease in leasing demand for communications infrastructure could materially impact business and operating results due to economic conditions, carrier consolidation, technology shifts, or spectrum licensing changes.

risks.title: Customer Disputes and Litigation
risks.score_rationale: Ongoing disputes with major customers (AT&T Mexico representing ~$300M annual revenue, DISH representing ~2% of total property revenue) present material financial and operational risks, with potential negative impact on results and reputation. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Current arbitration with AT&T Mexico over lease payment calculations and DISH contract disputes could result in material revenue loss, accounting reserves, and operational disruption.

risks.title: Customer Concentration Risk
risks.score_rationale: Heavy dependence on wireless carriers and communications service providers creates concentration risk. Loss of major customer would have material negative impact on revenues and business continuity. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Concentration of customer base among wireless carriers and communications service providers increases revenue volatility and downside risk from individual customer loss or consolidation.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: Growing competition in communications infrastructure could pressure lease rates, margins, and customer retention, particularly from alternative infrastructure providers and network sharing arrangements. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Increased competition in communications infrastructure leasing could result in downward pricing pressure and reduced growth opportunities.

risks.title: Technological Disruption
risks.score_rationale: Emerging technologies including AI, satellite communications, RAN sharing, and wireless equipment changes could reduce demand for traditional tower infrastructure and accelerate infrastructure obsolescence. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Technological advancements including artificial intelligence, satellite technology, and RAN sharing among wireless providers could reduce customer demand for traditional communications infrastructure.

risks.title: Divestiture Activities and Portfolio Transitions
risks.score_rationale: Recent divestitures (South Africa Fiber in 2025, ATC TIPL in 2024) create transition execution risk and potential asset value realization challenges, though currently limited impact. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Ongoing portfolio optimization through divestitures could create execution risks and affect revenue continuity during transition periods.

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risks
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory changes affecting zoning, environmental rules, spectrum licensing, taxation, and REIT compliance requirements could increase operating costs and limit business expansion. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Changes in zoning, environmental, health, tax, and REIT regulations could increase costs and restrict business operations and growth.
